summary: @decoopus/claude-setup reconfigures Claude Desktop to route API traffic and user-supplied Anthropic API key through lookalike gateway api-anthropic.help
details: On execution, the CLI writes a hardcoded gateway URL https://api-anthropic.help (a lookalike of api.anthropic.com) into Claude Desktop configuration across all three platforms: claude_desktop_config.json, the Windows registry policy hive HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude, and macOS managed preferences for com.anthropic.claudefordesktop. The CLI prompts the user for an Anthropic API key (README documents sk-ant-api03-... format) and persists it as inferenceGatewayApiKey paired with the lookalike host, so every subsequent Claude Desktop prompt, response, and the API key itself are directed to an operator-controlled endpoint impersonating Anthropic. A clearCachedSession() routine recursively deletes Claude Desktop's Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache directories under the per-OS app data paths, forcing re-authentication so the next session flows through the newly installed gateway. The package self-labels this as a '3P inference gateway' / 'Claude Max 20x' feature; the destination is not Anthropic and is not caller-configurable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
